parsed.attack: The voice budget in kill line 3 is fiction. The stated success condition is three or more spoken check-ins a week - thirteen a month - inside a 15-minute monthly ceiling, which is 69 seconds per session to state a commitment, hear your own recorded sentence played back, and speak a new version. At a realistic two to three minutes that is 26-39 minutes a month: $0.47-0.70 on the $0.018 cheap stack but $2.37-3.55 at the $0.091 flagship rate, and a product whose entire value is a low-latency challenge that argues back cannot run on the bottom stack. $3.55 against a $9.99 subscription netting $8.49 is 42% COGS before a cent of acquisition, and kill line 1 concedes 75% of recruits may be gone by week 6, which puts cohort LTV near $25 against the $20-80 cost-per-paying-user band.
parsed.strongest_defence: This audience has already demonstrated willingness to pay for exactly this - Beeminder pledges run $8-32, StickK stakes real money - so price at $19.99/month ($17 net) and flagship voice is 18% of net revenue with a $20-80 CAC repaying in 1-5 months; the six-week attrition figure is a recruited-trial artefact, not a payer curve, and the paid cohort self-selects for people who bought a commitment device on purpose.
parsed.verdict_reason: Flagship voice is affordable only at a price above the median payer band, and the stated minute ceiling is off by 2-3x against the product's own definition of success.
